data.gender_notes: Calistina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek, Calistina is derived from the Greek word 'kalos' meaning beautiful or handsome and 'stine' meaning strength or endurance. In Christian tradition, it is believed to represent the most beautiful virtue and strength. The name Calistina carries the meaning “Most beautiful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Calistina usually hope their child will grow to embody most beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: קאליסטינה
in_hebrew.meaning: השם קאליסטינה נגזר מיוונית ופירושו יופי טוב
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קאליסטינה מקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו יופי טוב או יופי נפלא. הוא נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'קאלוס' שפירושה יופי ו'טינוס' שפירושה טוב או נפלא. השם קאליסטינה הוא שם נוצרי שמשמעותו רוחנית ומתארת אדם עם יופי פנימי וטוב לב.

in_greek.name: Καλιστίνα
in_greek.meaning: Το όνομα Καλιστίνα σημαίνει καλό και ωραίο
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Καλιστίνα προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'καλός' που σημαίνει καλό και 'τίνος' που σημαίνει κάτι που ανήκει σε κάτι άλλο. Στην ουσία, το όνομα Καλιστίνα σημαίνει καλό και ωραίο ή ωραία και καλή. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Καλιστίνα έχει συσχετιστεί με την έννοια της πνευματικής ομορφιάς και της εσωτερικής καλοσύνης.

in_english.name: Calistina
in_english.meaning: The name Calistina means beautiful and good

Today, Calistina remains a popular name in many Christian cultures, symbolizing virtues of beauty and goodness.

data.cultural_impact: The name Calistina can be found in various works of literature and art throughout history, from the Greek goddess Calisthenes, who represented beauty and endurance, to the title character in the novel "Calisthenes, or the Beautiful and the Strong" by French writer Paul de Kock. This name carries an aura of elegance, grace, and strength, which has made it a popular choice for girls in many cultures.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Calistina represents the ideal combination of inner beauty and outer strength that a person should strive to possess. Additionally, the name Calistina can be a source of inspiration for those seeking to live up to the highest standards of character and integrity, as represented by the stunning, enduring beauty of this powerful name.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Calistina: Dedicated to Calistus, a legendary early Christian martyr, symbolizing strength, perseverance, and unwavering faith in the face of adversity.
